                        if not (dir_mask & (1 << j)):
                            adj_current[u].append(v)
                        else:
                            adj_current[v].append(u)
                    # Now, for each special vertex s, perform BFS to find reachable vertices
                    reachable_from_special = [set() for _ in range(k)]
                    for s_idx in range(k):
                        s = v_special[s_idx] - 1
                        visited = [False] * n
                        q = deque()
                        q.append(s)
                        visited[s] = True
                        while q:
                            u = q.popleft()
                            for v in adj_current[u]:
                                if not visited[v]:
                                    visited[v] = True
                                    q.append(v)
                        for u in range(n):
                            if visited[u]:
                                reachable_from_special[s_idx].add(u)
                    # The saturated vertices are the intersection of all reachable_from_special sets
                    saturated = set(range(n))
                    for s_set in reachable_from_special:
                        saturated.intersection_update(s_set)
                    # Check if target is in saturated
                    if target in saturated:
                        # Compute profit
                        total_c = sum(c[j] for j in saturated)
                        total_w = sum(w[j] for j in undirected_edges)
                        profit = total_c - total_w
                        if profit > max_profit_for_target:
                            max_profit_for_target = profit
        max_profit[target] = max_profit_for_target

    # Output the results for vertices 1 to n
    for i in range(n):
        print(max_profit[i], end=' ')
    print()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
